summary: A distributor can send its buyer straight to the processor once the counted material is ready to ship.
realLife: In 2023 testimony on Maine LD 1909, outgoing CLYNK CEO Alison Vanderhoof said many CLYNK partners directed their commodity buyers to the company's dock instead of handling the processed containers again.
